flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui App.tsx (empty COURT block), pages/Report/{index,action/ActionReport} (Court Application Vault/Submit Reports menu entries are placeholders, resource commented out), pages/Notice/form/History (Court Application History tab commented out); ocmsadminapi api-authorization.properties (/v1/courtcase listed without a controller), crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsCourtCase. No screen listing selected notices or their summary
note: The story asks for a screen listing the notices selected for court application plus a count summary. No screen, route or API exists for it. The 'Court Application Vault Reports' and 'Court Application Submit Reports' report entries are placeholders (empty path, resource commented out), and the 'Court Application History' tab in notice detail is commented out. The story depends on the OCMS22.1 selection, which also has no code. No relevant maintenance ticket. The 'Fully paid' status is not backed by code in the six repos.
recommendation: Do not claim as done based on the code in these six repos. Ask URA/the team in which repo the selected notices list screen was built, or mark as a gap

steps.step: Officer opens the selected notices screen after the selection has run
steps.detail: There is no court application route or page in ocmsadminui: the '{/* COURT */}' block is empty (App.tsx:313) and the system block only holds parameter, standardcode, computer-rule-code, suspension-reason, schedule-public-holiday (App.tsx:375-500). The 'Court Application Vault Reports' menu entry is a placeholder with path "" (Report/index.tsx:61-64).

steps.step: OCMS displays the list of selected notices, whether picked automatically or added manually
steps.detail: The 'Court Application Vault Reports' and 'Court Application Submit Reports' report menu entries are placeholders only: path "" (Report/index.tsx:61-68) and the courtcasesummary resource is commented out (ActionReport.tsx:36-49). The 'Court Application History' tab in notice detail that reads the courtcase resource is also commented out (History.tsx:170-172), and it is per-notice history, not a selection list.

steps.step: OCMS displays a summary of the number of selected notices
steps.detail: There is no summary/count component for court application notices; the courtcasesummary resource is commented out (ActionReport.tsx:38-41,45-48) and the CA/CAE type filter is inactive.

steps.step: The list and summary data are loaded from the backend for eligible or manually added notices
steps.detail: The path /v1/courtcase is listed in api-authorization.properties:23,32,41,51 but there is no courtcase or courtcasesummary controller in ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminprivateapi or thirdpartyapi (grep 0 results); OcmsCourtCaseRepository only has findByNoticeNo (OcmsCourtCaseRepository.java:19-21). Checked with the synonyms court application, court batch, courtapp, shortlist, eligible court, weekly across the six repos (UI and API).
